**" She's in some deep shit,"** a top Donald Trump adviser frankly informs
**Zeteo** , referring to the U.S. president's White House chief of staff and
2024 campaign co-chief, Susie Wiles.

Talk to people in and out of government who are very close to Trump, and it
won't take long for you to hear that despite the president's public bravado
and projections of confidence, he knows how spectacularly in-the-toilet his
poll numbers are, at this midway point of his violently authoritarian second
term.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

He's looking for people to blame, because he doesn't want to look in the[
mirror in his disgusting-carpeted bathroom](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-the-
bathroom-slob) and blame the one man most responsible for his failures and
humiliations. The 2026 midterms are around the corner, and if the polls are
right, the American people are on track to deliver a mammoth repudiation.

On Thursday morning, _Politico_
[reported](https://www.politico.com/newsletters/playbook/2026/10/15/trumps-
ice-maiden-is-under-fire-01119850) that Trump has been actively weighing
dumping Wiles as the midterms near and as he and his party hunt for
scapegoats. If disaster strikes the GOP in November, expect a ton of
backbiting and anonymous score-settling in the media. For instance, we keep
hearing about how numerous Republican operatives, Trumpworld figures, and
conservatives on Capitol Hill absolutely despise the notably smug James Blair,
a former deputy chief of staff who now has the likely impossible task of
somehow salvaging the midterms for Trump, and wouldn't mind cynically
shoveling blame on him for the heavy losses, should they occur in the House
and Senate.

When it comes to Wiles, Trump and his White House tried to pour cold water on
the _Politico_ story, releasing effusively supportive statements, the
president accusing the outlet of - what else? - **" TOTAL FAKE NEWS**."

**"**_**Politico**_**doesn 't care about facts, integrity, or honest
journalism," **Trump bleated. **" It's why I kicked them out of the White
House!** [Before a judge ordered they and CNN and MS NOW be let back in.]
**Susie Wiles is my loyal and longest serving Chief of Staff - there is a
reason for that. She has been with me since the beginning, is my trusted
advisor, and has my COMPLETE confidence."**

I can confirm _Politico_ had it right.
